task.title: Acknowledged replay-preserving compaction
task.specification: Config readers is a nonempty list. Start sequence=0, empty log, each reader acknowledgment=0. Events set{key,value},ack{reader,seq},compact. Set increments sequence and appends {seq,key,value}. Ack succeeds only if old_ack<=seq<=current_sequence; otherwise unchanged. Compact watermark=min(reader acknowledgments): keep every log record above watermark, plus exactly the latest record at or below watermark for each key that has one. Preserve sequence order. Output {log:[retained sequence numbers],view:{key:latest value from all writes}} after each event. Compaction never changes visible values; unacknowledged records cannot be discarded. Values are integers. Implement pure solve({config,state,event})->{state,output}, initially state=null. Only the current event is supplied; every named event uses a type field, e.g. {type:"restore"}. Return exactly the stated output fields each step; opaque JSON state is not graded. All numeric inputs and intermediate arithmetic are safe integers; time deltas are nonnegative. Unless a task explicitly overrides this, keys, snapshot IDs, readers and graph nodes are single lowercase ASCII letters. Integral JSON number spellings such as 1 and 1.0 are equivalent; booleans remain distinct from numbers. At most eight identities and 48 events occur. Configurations and event fields shown below are present. Ordinary regimes use moderate storage and timing; boundary uses equality/empty states; adversarial repeats stale/conflicting events; shift uses smaller capacity, longer timing gaps or deeper dependency shapes, without changing these rules. Generator regimes: Shift uses four readers versus ordinary two, making independent acknowledgment lag more likely. Adversarial traces add adjacent repeated events, capped at 48; those events obey the same contract.

matchedCard.label: Archival provenance and original order
matchedCard.relation: The origin and original arrangement of records preserve relationships that can be lost when the same contents are rearranged arbitrarily. A later description or arrangement is distinct from evidence of the organization in which the records were produced.
assumptions: The origin or original order is known or supported by evidence.
Relationships among records contribute to their interpretation.
matchedCard.boundary: Original order can be lost or disrupted. A newly devised arrangement does not establish that it was the historical arrangement, and provenance does not make every recorded claim true.
matchedCard.source_fact: The National Archives explains provenance, preserving or restoring original order, and devising arrangements when necessary, emphasizing the evidential significance of context.

shuffledCard.label: Seed banking
shuffledCard.relation: Preserving a reserve and preserving its ability to reactivate are different conditions. Suitable material remains in controlled storage, while periodic sample recovery provides evidence of continued viability. Duplicate holdings reduce dependence on one location.
assumptions: The material tolerates the chosen storage treatment.
Samples provide relevant evidence about the collection they represent.
Duplicate collections remain identifiable as corresponding holdings.
shuffledCard.boundary: Some material cannot survive drying or freezing. Successful retention alone does not demonstrate viability, and sampled viability is not certainty about every stored item.
shuffledCard.source_fact: Kew stores suitable dried seeds in cold vaults, periodically tests germination, and commonly duplicates holdings in their country of origin. Some seeds do not tolerate conventional storage.

sources.title: How to preserve seeds for the future

initial.explanation: Use the conditional rule: an acknowledgment may advance a reader only when it is no older than that reader's prior acknowledgment and no newer than the current sequence. Compaction retains all records above the minimum acknowledgment and the latest record at or below it for each key. A simpler deletion rule fails when the retained record is the only historical value needed to preserve replay-visible state.
initial.mapping: state.seq is the current sequence; state.log stores retained {seq,key,value} records; state.ack stores reader watermarks; state.view stores latest values from all writes. The output derives log sequence numbers and view.
initial.assumptions: Inputs follow the stated legal contract: configured readers and event fields are valid, values and arithmetic are safe integers, and only set, ack, and compact events occur.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){var r=input.config.readers,s=0,l=[],a={},v={},want=[];for(var i=0;i<r.length;i++)a[r[i]]=0;for(var e of input.events){if(e.type==='set'){s++;l.push({seq:s,key:e.key,value:e.value});v[e.key]=e.value}else if(e.type==='ack'){if(a[e.reader]<=e.seq&&e.seq<=s)a[e.reader]=e.seq}else{var w=Infinity;for(var k of r)if(a[k]<w)w=a[k];var last={},n=[];for(var x of l)if(x.seq<=w)last[x.key]=x;for(var x of l)if(x.seq>w||last[x.key]===x)n.push(x);l=n}var o={log:l.map(x=>x.seq),view:Object.assign({},v)};want.push(o)}return JSON.stringify(want)===JSON.stringify(output)}
initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state;if(s===null){s={seq:0,log:[],ack:{},view:{}};for(var r of config.readers)s.ack[r]=0}if(event.type==='set'){s.seq++;s.log.push({seq:s.seq,key:event.key,value:event.value});s.view[event.key]=event.value}else if(event.type==='ack'){var old=s.ack[event.reader];if(old<=event.seq&&event.seq<=s.seq)s.ack[event.reader]=event.seq}else if(event.type==='compact'){var w=Infinity,last={},n=[];for(var r of config.readers)if(s.ack[r]<w)w=s.ack[r];for(var x of s.log)if(x.seq<=w)last[x.key]=x;for(var x of s.log)if(x.seq>w||last[x.key]===x)n.push(x);s.log=n}return{state:s,output:{log:s.log.map(x=>x.seq),view:Object.assign({},s.view)}}}

final.explanation: Maintains sequence, retained records, reader acknowledgments, and the latest visible value per key. Sets append records and update the view. Acknowledgments advance only within the permitted interval. Compaction computes the minimum acknowledgment, preserves all newer records, and preserves the latest record at or below the watermark for every key, maintaining sequence order.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state;if(s===null){s={seq:0,log:[],ack:{},view:{}};for(var i=0;i<config.readers.length;i++)s.ack[config.readers[i]]=0}if(event.type==='set'){s.seq++;s.log.push({seq:s.seq,key:event.key,value:event.value});s.view[event.key]=event.value}else if(event.type==='ack'){var old=s.ack[event.reader];if(old<=event.seq&&event.seq<=s.seq)s.ack[event.reader]=event.seq}else if(event.type==='compact'){var w=Infinity,last={},keep=[];for(var i=0;i<config.readers.length;i++){var a=s.ack[config.readers[i]];if(a<w)w=a}for(var i=0;i<s.log.length;i++){var x=s.log[i];if(x.seq<=w)last[x.key]=x}for(var i=0;i<s.log.length;i++){var x=s.log[i];if(x.seq>w||last[x.key]===x)keep.push(x)}s.log=keep}var log=[];for(var i=0;i<s.log.length;i++)log.push(s.log[i].seq);return{state:s,output:{log:log,view:Object.assign({},s.view)}}}

initial.explanation: Retain log order while advancing acknowledgments monotonically. Compaction uses the minimum acknowledgment watermark: records above it remain, and each key keeps its latest record at or below it. The visible view tracks the latest value from every write.
initial.mapping: Sequence maps to append order; log stores records; acknowledgments establish the safe watermark; view maps each written key to its latest value.
initial.assumptions: Readers are the configured identities, event fields are valid, values are integers, and all inputs obey the stated bounds.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let s=null;for(let i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){let r=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:input.events[i]});if(JSON.stringify(r.output)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false;s=r.state}return true}
initial.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(s===null){s={n:0,l:[],a:{},v:{}};for(var i=0;i<c.readers.length;i++)s.a[c.readers[i]]=0}if(e.type==='set'){s.n++;s.l.push({q:s.n,k:e.key,v:e.value});s.v[e.key]=e.value}else if(e.type==='ack'){var old=s.a[e.reader];if(old!==undefined&&old<=e.seq&&e.seq<=s.n)s.a[e.reader]=e.seq}else if(e.type==='compact'){var w=Infinity,i,j,keep={},z=[];for(i=0;i<c.readers.length;i++)if(s.a[c.readers[i]]<w)w=s.a[c.readers[i]];for(i=0;i<s.l.length;i++)if(s.l[i].q<=w)keep[s.l[i].k]=i;for(i=0;i<s.l.length;i++)if(s.l[i].q>w||keep[s.l[i].k]===i)z.push(s.l[i]);s.l=z}var o={log:[],view:{}};for(var i=0;i<s.l.length;i++){o.log.push(s.l[i].q);o.view[s.l[i].k]=s.l[i].v}for(var k in s.v)if(!(k in o.view))o.view[k]=s.v[k];return{state:s,output:o}}

final.explanation: The state tracks the current sequence, retained records, reader acknowledgments, and the latest value for every key. Sets append records and update visibility. Valid acknowledgments advance monotonically only within the current sequence range. Compaction computes the minimum acknowledgment, retains all records above it, and retains the latest at-or-below-watermark record for each key. The output log is ordered by sequence, while the view includes the latest value from all writes, including values represented only by compacted history.

initial.explanation: Maintain sequence, retained records, acknowledgments, and visible latest values. Sets append records. Valid acknowledgments advance only within the reader's current causal range. Compaction retains all records above the minimum acknowledgment and the newest record at or below it for each key, preserving order and visibility.
initial.mapping: Sequence maps to write order; log stores retained {seq,key,value} records; acknowledgments map each configured reader to its acknowledged sequence; view maps each key to its latest value.
initial.assumptions: Inputs follow the stated contract: configured readers are nonempty, event fields are present and valid, values are integers, and numeric operations are safe. State is trusted only as state produced by this program.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const x of output){if(!x||!Array.isArray(x.log)||!x.view||typeof x.view!=='object')return false;for(const n of x.log)if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n))return false;}return true;}

final.explanation: Maintain the sequence, retained write records, per-reader acknowledgments, and latest visible value for each key. A set appends a write and updates the view. An acknowledgment advances only when it is within the reader’s monotonic valid range. Compaction computes the minimum acknowledgment, preserves every record above it, and preserves the latest record at or below it for each key, retaining sequence order.
